purpose: Audit clipping and information-matrix choices in the existing one-step comparator across every original finite-pool condition
source_formula_units: PDF Section 6.2, Eq. (8), one-step display on page 11, Corollary 5 on page 12, Appendix B on page 26
pilot: Original unique human ridge fit, penalty ||beta||^2/(2m), shared across all prediction and auxiliary conditions on the same original draw
weight: Source trace convention: labelled cross-covariance divisor m; pooled surrogate covariance divisor m+N-1; scalar trace tuning. Pooled information reproduces the existing comparator; labelled information corresponds to the displayed Eq. (8)
step: Exactly one undamped update using (1-lambda)H_label+lambda H_aux and the compensated original-loss gradient, including unrestricted real lambda
numerical_rule: No jitter, damping, winsorization, response filtering or adaptive power limits. Retain every unresolved case. Require finite coefficients and scaled linear-solve residual <=1e-8. Record curvature eigenvalues and condition number
endpoints: expected new-row human excess log loss on the full 1200-profile support
original_clipped_comparator_reconciliati: Every one of 24 old aggregate cells; 500 repetitions each; estimate counts exact and MSE/loss differences reported before interpretation
